pairs.why: Both deliver every stated requirement with sound audit, timestamps, per-assignment notification keys, persistence and paging, and both document and version the release. X's edges (strict UTF-8, refusing impossible filter values, a decision record) are balanced by Y's (trimmed names consistent with the requester rule, rollback on every failed save, notification addressing documented) and each carries a small cost (X ships harness cruft and untrimmed names, Y changes repeated-filter behaviour). No difference here would change how an operator runs or keeps the feature.
